name: zodiacs-developer
description: Build and verify astrology integrations with the published Zodiacs engine, bounded sky tools and local chart comparison.

interface.longDescription:
Developed by Zodiacs LLC, the operator of Zodiacs.org. Build Moon widgets, sky calendars and astrology APIs with the published Zodiacs engine. Verify calculation records and test timezones with synthetic inputs. The local developer server supports natal calculations without a listener or outbound connection; the assistant provider can still receive inputs and results. Chart Studio adds an interactive browser panel for inspecting placements, comparing house systems and downloading records. Sharing a selection with the assistant requires a review and explicit action. Public directory availability is not offered by this review candidate.

Official website: https://zodiacs.org/ . Company and contact: https://zodiacs.org/about/ . Support: admin@zodiacs.org . Methods and developer documentation: https://zodiacs.org/developers/ . Privacy and terms are linked in this profile.
